text:
anna: Customer Z wants per-route cost rollups and a quick link from a high-cost request to a short serving trace + error marker. They need a proposal by sprint end.

rao: We can emit a tiny event at request end with queue_ms, kernel_ms, post_ms, kvcache_ms and estimated_cost_cents. Keep it flat and cheap.

claire: Console should show: top routes by cost, per-route trend, and a recent-samples table with a trace link. Trace modal must highlight error spans.

dave: Implementation note: measure kernel_ms with a single atomic timestamp delta. Sampling full spans at 0.5% should keep overhead negligible. Add runtime kill-switch.

sara: Billing needs CSV columns: invoice_customer_id, request_id, route, model_alias, cost_cents, ts. No payloads. I'll provide pricing mapping.

anna: MVP scope proposal: 1) 100% tiny cost events, 2) 0.5% sampled full spans with error flagging, 3) two console widgets (top cost routes, recent sampled traces) and CSV export.

rao: Rough estimate: 2.5 dev-weeks. Risks: pricing mapping for quantized variants and ensuring event emission cheap.

claire: UX deliverables: wireframe for widgets and trace modal. I can finish mock by Wednesday.

dave: Canary plan: enable sampling for internal org + 2 pilot customers for 72h, run compare job between sampled aggregates and invoice calc. Pause if >20% variance.

sara: I'll produce pricing table keys and privacy rules. Agree to anonymize model names to aliases.

infra-bot: feature-flag created: ff.showback_trace_samples. Staging rollout scheduled 2026-04-08T09:00Z.

anna: Next steps: Rao drafts schema and RFC, Claire attaches mockups, Sara supplies pricing extract. Quick sync Friday 11am. Thanks everyone :rocket:
